Our Process

STEP 01

FIRST CONTACT

Reach out to us via telephone, email, or our contact form.

We promptly respond to your inquiry to schedule an initial consultation.

The first step is about understanding your basic legal needs & setting up a meeting (either in-person or video call).

STEP 02

INITIAL CONSULTATION

Meet with our experienced solicitors for a detailed consultation. Here, we discuss:

– The specifics of your case;

– Answer your questions; and

– Outline potential legal strategies.

This meeting can be in-person or virtual, depending on your preference.

STEP 03

CASE EVALUATION

Our team evaluates your situation to determine the best course of action.

Whether it’s a personal matter or a business-related issue, we develop a step-by-step plan tailored to your specific legal needs.

STEP 04

TRANSPARENT FEE STRUCTURE

We provide a clear & honest breakdown of our fee structure.

Understanding the cost of legal services is an important factor.

We ensure you have all the information needed to make informed decisions (without any hidden surprises).

STEP 05

ONGOING COMMUNICATION

Throughout your case, we maintain regular communication.

You’ll receive updates about the progress & developments of your case.

Our experienced team will keep you informed & involved at every stage.

STEP 06

RESOLUTION & FOLLOW-UP

At Nooney & Dowdall LLP, our team work towards a resolution of your case.

Whether it’s a settlement, negotiation, or trial, our solicitors aim for the best outcome.

After the case concludes, we’re available for any follow-up questions or additional legal guidance.
